observation.subject: GET /api/bank-accounts
observation.sentence: `GET /api/bank-accounts`: warm median 4.5 ms over 26 requests; Handler: BankAccountResource.getAllBankAccounts 36 %, Other handler time 18 %, Other filters 15 %. Median CPU 4.5 ms and 268 KB allocated per request. First request 2.8 ms (cold).
whatToCheck: Most of the time is in BankAccountResource.getAllBankAccounts: open Code Paths for this route to see what it calls and who calls it.
limitations: 12 warm requests were answered 401 or 403 before reaching a handler BootUI marks, as security filters do when they reject a request, so they are left out of the phases.

The handler's other work is split by method from the BootUI agent's code paths over 25 warm requests: each method takes the share its own time has of the handler, its self time minus the SQL, REST client, cache, and AI calls stamped to it, which are already named.
observation.unlistedReason: Its warm median is under 20 ms, and authorization takes under 20 % of its time and under 50 decisions a request, so it is not prominent.
